covered_report_window: After U.S. market close Thursday, July 30, 2026, and before U.S. market open Friday, July 31, 2026.
market_context_summary: The run occurred while U.S. markets were open. The market was rebounding after a sharp Fed/oil/geopolitical selloff, Microsoft strength was offset by Meta weakness, AI capex scrutiny was intense, and energy prices/geopolitical risk remained important for the Friday oil-major reports.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: First Solar has the cleanest positive setup because backlog visibility and prior guidance support a beat-quality thesis without the same AI-capex crowding risk as tech.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Confirmed after-close timing; consensus EPS around $2.99 in the weekly calendar; Q1 showed $1.04B net sales, $3.22 EPS, and 47.9 GW contracted backlog.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog conversion, margin resilience, and reaffirmed or raised guidance could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Policy, tariff, factory ramp, or margin commentary could overwhelm a headline beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found; event risk treated as moderate.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published previews emphasize backlog and guidance durability more than headline EPS.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Coinbase has a bearish operating setup because trading volumes and transaction revenue look weak, but the name carries very high relief-squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed after-close timing; previews cite a Q2 loss, revenue around $1.29B-$1.30B, lower trading volumes, and regulatory focus around the Clarity Act.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Stablecoin/subscription revenue, Bitcoin strength, or regulatory optimism could squeeze the stock higher.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak retail and institutional trading plus restructuring costs could pressure the stock.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options sources cited roughly 9% expected move; high beta and retail attention raise reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimates moved lower, but the low bar may not fully offset volume weakness.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Eaton screens positively after a sharp pre-report pullback because electrical backlog and margin guidance remain the key stock-moving factors.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed before-open timing; Q2 EPS/revenue expectations cluster near $3.07 and $8.16B; Q1 guide framed adjusted EPS around $3.00-$3.10 and strong margins.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Electrical backlog, data-center demand, and margins could clear the reset bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A softer guide or AI-power order slowdown could punish the premium multiple.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found; recent sharp underperformance partially de-risks the setup.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Expectations remain high, but recent price action lowers the near-term hurdle.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Rivian has a modest upside setup because Q2 production/delivery data and raised delivery guidance improve the bar, but margins and cash burn still dominate.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed after-close timing; Q2 production/delivery release raised 2026 delivery guidance to 65,000-70,000 vehicles in third-party coverage.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Better gross margin, reaffirmed raised deliveries, and R2/Volkswagen software-platform confidence could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Losses, cash burn, or margin disappointment could quickly reverse the relief setup.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found; EV retail attention keeps two-way risk elevated.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Delivery guidance moved up, but earnings quality depends on margin and cash use.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Amazon leans up on AWS acceleration, but the market may punish any capex step-up that lacks clear cash-flow payoff.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed 5 p.m. ET call; consensus revenue is around $197B-$200B and AWS growth is expected near 31%. Options pricing suggests about a 6% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: AWS growth above expectations with disciplined capex and strong retail/ads could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A higher capex outlook without clear monetization could overwhelm a good quarter.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts remain broadly constructive, but the bar is AWS plus spending discipline.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Reddit has upside if ad growth and DAU quality beat, but valuation and AI-traffic worries cap conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed after-close timing; estimates cluster around roughly $0.95-$0.99 EPS and about $731M-$745M revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Ad growth, engagement, and better data-licensing economics could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Slowing user growth or AI search reducing direct traffic could drive a selloff.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options AI cited about a 12.3% expected move, indicating a high hurdle.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence points to high growth expectations; confidence capped by valuation and event-volatility hurdle.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Chevron is constructive but slightly less asymmetric than Exxon because a strong July rally and commodity volatility may already price much of the Q2 tailwind.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company IR lists the Jul 31 earnings call; Kiplinger/IBD previews cite high EPS expectations amid oil strength.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Strong commodity earnings and continued cash returns could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Oil reversal or cautious project commentary could cap the reaction.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found; commodity beta is the main positioning risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Bank of America raised its target in preview coverage, but the stock was already strong.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Exxon’s Q2 bridge is supportive, but the stock’s strong year-to-date move lowers the surprise factor.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Official release is due Jul 31 before the open; company update and previews point to large upstream and refining benefits.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Higher liquids prices and refining margins could support a beat.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A confirmation-only print could fade if oil softens or cash-return tone disappoints.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found; commodity and crowded-energy risk dominate.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimates were raised into the print, reducing incremental surprise potential.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Apple’s fundamentals look solid, but the event setup is tactically tough because expectations, valuation, and forward margin questions require a nearly flawless print.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Apple confirmed a 5 p.m. ET call; consensus centers around $1.89 EPS and roughly $109B revenue, with iPhone revenue growth the key metric.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: iPhone/services strength and benign margin commentary could overcome the priced-in setup.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Pull-forward, memory-cost pressure, or underwhelming AI/leadership commentary could sink the stock despite a beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Barron's/OptionCharts cited a roughly 3%-4% expected move and muted historical Apple reactions.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Morgan Stanley raised its target but also framed the tactical setup as tougher near highs.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Roblox leans down because bookings and user-quality concerns remain the likely stock-moving metric, but high volatility creates major relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed after-close timing; Q1 showed strong revenue/bookings but guidance changes and safety-related engagement concerns remain important.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings acceleration, DAU stabilization, or raised guidance could squeeze the stock higher.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Weak bookings quality, DAU softness, or guidance caution could trigger another high-volatility drop.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: OptionCharts cited an expected move near 14%; prior earnings reaction was also large.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence is mixed, so confidence stays capped.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strategy leans down on accounting and funding-risk optics, but the stock is too tied to Bitcoin and narrative flows for a high-confidence bearish call.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company IR lists a Jul 30 5 p.m. ET webinar; previews emphasize Bitcoin-related accounting volatility and balance-sheet issues.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bitcoin strength or bullish treasury/funding commentary could squeeze the stock higher.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Large accounting losses, dilution/funding concerns, or weak enterprise-software tone could pressure shares.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found; narrative beta and Bitcoin linkage drive very high reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Earnings quality is less useful than balance-sheet and Bitcoin sensitivity.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Dexcom has a plausible recovery setup, but the stock-moving issue is guidance quality amid competitive CGM pressure, leaving no clear edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed after-close timing; IR materials indicate 2026 guidance was reiterated previously.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A guide raise or evidence of share stabilization could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Pricing, competitive share, or weaker guidance could renew prior selloff patterns.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence was not strong enough for a directional call.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AbbVie’s evidence quality is strong, but the event setup is balanced because immunology strength and a high stock price offset each other.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Company confirmed before-open timing; previews expect EPS around $3.60-$3.66 and revenue around $16.8B, with Skyrizi/Rinvoq growth central.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Immunology and neuroscience strength with maintained guidance could lift shares.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Any post-Humira transition or pipeline caution could pressure a stock near highs.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move source found; defensive profile lowers reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Several firms raised targets into earnings, increasing the hurdle for upside surprise.
